name: browser/goto
description: Put a URL in the address bar of the browser that is already in front, and go. The one shortcut every web script starts with.

steps.note: Focuses and selects the whole address bar in Chrome, Edge and Firefox alike. Finding it as an element instead would be three different selectors and would break on a redesign.
No `into`: ctrl+l already put the caret there.
Waits for the page to actually load AND re-points the scene at the loaded window, which a bare wait would not do.
